key_decisions.decision: Reads the desired things collectively with the plural verb, without imposing a personal messianic referent.
Keeps the indirect-contact distinction essential to the question and the full food list.
Distinguishes direct corpse-related uncleanness from the previous indirect holiness transfer.
Keeps the divine first-person assessment and the relation to offerings.
Preserves the temporal hinge while signaling the retrospective comparison that follows.
Preserves all four numbers while leaving the source’s unstated units nonspecific.
Retains the three afflictions and supplies the return verb demanded by the elliptical relational clause.
Preserves the repeated summons and exact foundation date.
Retains the question, all four plants, and the promise before visible yield.
